label: halloweennao2
title_zh: 湖边的房子（还是老地方）

lines.en: It isn’t much longer before I realize where we’re going.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我就明白我们要去哪儿了。
但比这更重要的是——
可能正在发生什么。

lines.en: It’s cause for concern, sure. But at the same time...maybe this is a good thing?
lines.zh: 当然，这值得担心。可与此同时……说不定这是件好事？

lines.en: Assuming I’m right, that is. Which I very rarely am.
lines.zh: 前提是我没猜错。而我几乎从来没猜对过。

lines.en: But I have seen this sky before under different, often better circumstances. And while the irony that I’d find it the moment I stop looking is undoubtedly comical, it’s also kind of sad.
lines.zh: 但我在别的、往往更好的境况下见过这片天空。虽然我在停止寻找的那一刻反而找到了它，这种讽刺无疑很滑稽，但也有点可悲。

lines.en: I wonder if any of the others have realized it yet.
lines.zh: 不知道其他人有没有察觉到。

lines.en: I wonder what Ayane will do when she finds out her ultimate slumber party may not be happening for quite some time.
lines.zh: 不知道 Ayane 发现她那场终极睡衣派对可能要等上好一阵子才办得成时，会是什么反应。

lines.en: But the most wild thing I wonder is why something so conceptually terrifying suddenly puts my mind at ease.
lines.zh: 但我最疯狂的疑问是：为什么一个概念上如此可怖的东西，反而让我安心下来。

lines.en: I was nervous just before — not even thirty minutes ago. Could that have only been the case because of where I was and {i}not{/i} what loomed overhead?
lines.zh: 就在刚才——不到三十分钟前——我还紧张得要命。难道那只是因为我在什么地方，而{i}不是{/i}因为头顶上盘旋着什么？

lines.en: Maybe that’s why Maya, as small as she was, always managed to stand so tall during times like these. They were one of the only things that ever {i}really{/i} stayed the same.
lines.zh: 也许这就是为什么 Maya 明明个子那么小，在这种时候却总能站得那么高。它们是少数{i}真正{/i}从未改变过的东西之一。

lines.en: I’ll surely become her at this rate if I do not disappear— destined to chase something I’ll likely never reach.
lines.zh: 照这样下去，如果我不消失，我迟早会变成她——注定去追逐某个我大概永远够不到的东西。
但是……

lines.en: If what her shadow said earlier truly bore any hope-
lines.zh: 如果她的影子先前说的那些话当真有几分希望——

lines.en: If she really {i}is{/i} finally willing to hear my tragic tale of the girl she was before the girl she turned back into, wouldn’t it have been better to chase after her earlier?
lines.zh: 如果她{i}真的{/i}终于愿意听我讲那个悲惨的故事——讲她变回现在这个她之前，曾经是怎样的女孩——那我不是早该去追她了吗？

lines.en: I know what it’s like to be scared. Which is...probably why I {i}didn’t{/i} run her down earlier, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 我知道害怕是什么滋味。现在想想，大概正因如此，我刚才才{i}没有{/i}追上去把她拦下。

lines.en: I probably just didn’t want to see her like that. Mirrors have been hard enough to face lately, and we {i}all{/i} look the same when we lose what matters most.
lines.zh: 我大概只是不想看到她那个样子。最近连照镜子都够难熬了，而当我们失去最重要的东西时，{i}所有人{/i}看起来都一样。

lines.en: Wherever she is, I hope she can see this.
lines.zh: 无论她在哪里，我希望她能看到这个。

lines.en: And I hope it brings back both horrible and joyous memories.
lines.zh: 我希望它能唤回那些既可怖又欢喜的回忆。

lines.en: But for now, I’ll have to share the sights with a girl who surely cannot comprehend them.
lines.zh: 但现在，我只能和一个肯定无法理解它们的女孩分享这片景象。
又或者她能。

lines.en: And maybe that’s why she brought me here.
lines.zh: 也许这就是她带我来这儿的原因。
: 咯咯嗒！（回见，兄弟。）
: 哦，去你的。

lines.en: : If you’re telling me to thank him, no. It’s messed up that he’d just go back to communicating with me when I least need him to. He could have translated earlier.
lines.zh: : 如果你是想让我谢谢他，免了。我最不需要他的时候他反倒回来跟我说话了，这也太混蛋了。他早干嘛去了，早点翻译不行吗。
: 你听不懂他说话吗？
: 嗯。我猜——
突然，我的手机响了。

lines.en: It’s who it always is — my {i}daughter.{/i} Which means she’s either finally on the way to the party or has just {i}made{/i} it there and isn’t able to find me.
lines.zh: 打来的永远是同一个——我{i}女儿{/i}。这意味着她要么终于在来派对的路上，要么已经{i}到了{/i}却找不到我。

lines.en: Either that or she’s lost again. In more ways than one, I’m sure.
lines.zh: 要么就是她又迷路了。而且我敢肯定，她迷路的不只是路。

lines.en: But while that would normally worry me, I feel nothing now.
lines.zh: 换作平时我会担心，可现在我什么感觉都没有。
我不再害怕了。

lines.en: Because I know everything will go back to normal before we know it.
lines.zh: 因为我知道，一切很快就会恢复正常。

lines.en: I dismiss the call and retreat to a familiar sight — a new wallpaper, gifted to me by a close friend.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，退回一个熟悉的画面——一张新壁纸，是一个亲近的朋友送给我的。

lines.en: But it’s upon viewing said wallpaper that those fears I was so sure were gone just a second ago begin to crawl back toward me.
lines.zh: 可就在看到那张壁纸的瞬间，那些我前一秒还确信已经消失的恐惧，又开始朝我爬回来。

lines.en: : I don’t need to talk to her right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在不需要跟她说话。

lines.en: : Should you even be worried about that, Nao? You took me here for a reason, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你有什么好担心的，Nao？你带我来这儿是有原因的吧？

lines.en: : And I’m sure that reason isn’t just wanting to enroll at Kumon-mi High. Which is good because there’s no way you’re old enough to go there unless you really are an ancient monster.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢肯定，那个原因不会只是想入学 Kumon-mi 高中。这样也好，因为你的年纪根本不可能上那儿——除非你真是个上古怪物。

lines.en: : Yes, you — the girl who appeared out of nowhere and bears the eyes of the two most important girls in the world to me.
lines.zh: : 对，就是说你——那个凭空冒出来、却长着这世上对我最重要的两个女孩的眼睛的女孩。
: 别皱眉……

lines.en: : It makes me want to pet you.
lines.zh: : 你一皱眉，我就想摸摸你的头。

lines.en: : If that’s supposed to mean something-
lines.zh: : 如果那算是什么意思的话——

lines.en: : Oh, okay. I guess I’m following you again.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。看来我又得跟着你走了。

lines.en: Nao runs off toward the soccer field, as if I hadn’t already gotten my daily dose of nostalgia from returning to the one place I’ve spent almost as much time in as my home.
lines.zh: Nao 朝足球场跑去，仿佛我回到这个待的时间几乎和家一样长的地方，还没把今天的怀旧份额用光似的。

lines.en: But the nostalgia I speak of isn’t in relation to Miku. At least not...entirely.
lines.zh: 但我说的这份怀旧跟 Miku 无关。至少……不完全是。
那是某种更难以名状的东西。

lines.en: But somehow, {i}sometime...{/i}I feel like I have seen this before.
lines.zh: 但不知怎的，不知在{i}什么时候{/i}……我觉得我以前见过这个。

lines.en: I just can’t put my finger on {i}when.{/i}
lines.zh: 我只是说不出是{i}什么时候{/i}。

lines.en: : I really hope you didn’t take me all the way here to show me your mug collection.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你大老远把我带到这儿来，不是为了给我看你的马克杯收藏。

lines.en: I let out an audible sigh before-
lines.zh: 我发出一声听得见的叹息，然后——
在它……重新浮现之前。

lines.en: I just don’t know what {i}it{/i} is.
lines.zh: 我只是不知道{i}那{/i}是什么。

lines.en: She stares at me as if I know what to do.
lines.zh: 她盯着我，好像我知道该做什么似的。
而且……
我想我确实知道……
: 你是怎么——

lines.en: : What’s going to happen when I get inside?
lines.zh: : 我进去之后会发生什么？

lines.en: While I can’t make out her words or thoughts, her mannerisms calm me. But I think she might just be a special type of spider.
lines.zh: 虽然我听不懂她的话、猜不透她的心思，她的举止却让我平静下来。但我觉得她可能是某种特别的蜘蛛。

lines.en: The kind that relies not on placing her web in a place where those in search of sustenance may land, but the type who lures her prey back home.
lines.zh: 不是那种把网结在觅食者可能落下的地方守株待兔的蜘蛛，而是那种把猎物引回家的蜘蛛。

lines.en: What this means, though, is that I will be spared from her alleged proboscis and feel her fangs instead.
lines.zh: 不过这意味着，我大概能逃过她那根所谓的喙，转而尝到她的毒牙。
: 你能听懂我说话？
: 好吧。

lines.en: : This is why you brought me here, right? So I can see what’s inside of the doll house?
lines.zh: : 你带我来就是为了这个吧？好让我看看那座娃娃屋里面有什么？

lines.en: Her gaze tells me this is no doll house at all.
lines.zh: 她的眼神告诉我，这根本不是什么娃娃屋。
那是一扇门

lines.en: PLEASE BE ADVISED: PROCEEDING ANY FURTHER MAY-
lines.zh: 请注意：继续前行可能——
: 是的。

lines.en: PLEASE WAIT UNTIL THE ENTIRE WARNING MESSAGES PLAYS BEFORE
lines.zh: 请等待完整警告信息播放完毕后再——
: 是的。

lines.en: : I don’t care what the warning is. I don’t care what happens to me. I don’t care about anything.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎警告是什么。我不在乎我会发生什么。我什么都不在乎。
: 让我过去就行。
感谢您的配合。

lines.en: YOU ARE NOW BEING MOVED TO TERMINAL 22.
lines.zh: 现在将您转移至 22 号终端。
: Sekai 怎么样？

lines.en: : If we’re going to be thinking up names for our-
lines.zh: : 既然我们要给咱们的——想名字的话

lines.en: : Woah! Where did Yuu go? And who the hell are you?
lines.zh: : 哇哦！Yuu 跑哪儿去了？你他妈又是谁？

lines.en: : I have pepper spray, you know. And any second, my boyfriend will be back to kick your ass if you so much as think of-
lines.zh: : 我可有防狼喷雾。而且我男朋友随时会回来，你只要敢动一下念头，他就揍扁你——

lines.en: : I’m...not going to do anything to you, don’t worry. I don’t even really...know where I am right now.
lines.zh: : 我……不会对你怎么样的，别担心。我甚至……都不知道自己现在在哪儿。

lines.en: : So you sneak up on a girl in the middle of the night? Didn’t even want to...think about announcing your presence first?
lines.zh: : 所以你半夜三更偷袭一个姑娘？连……连先吭一声通报一下你的存在都不愿意？

lines.en: : I walked into a miniature house and got teleported here.
lines.zh: : 我走进了一栋小房子，然后就被传送到这儿了。
: 我知道这听起来有多荒唐。

lines.en: : Really? Because it sounds like you’re on drugs.
lines.zh: : 是吗？因为这听起来像是你嗑药了。

lines.en: : I’m not on drugs. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我没嗑药。我保证。

lines.en: : So what? Are you just looking for the way back to town? Just follow those stairs on your left and-
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？你只是想找回镇上的路？顺着你左边那道楼梯走下去就——
: 你……提到了 Sekai 这个名字。
: 我是提了。
: {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Sorry, but what does that have to do with your drug-addled desire to find your way home exactly?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，这跟你那个被药搞糊涂的、想找回家的念头到底有什么关系？

lines.en: : Just...I knew somebody by that name and...
lines.zh: : 只是……我认识一个叫这个名字的人，而且……

lines.en: : This just seems like too big of a coincidence to mean absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 这巧合也太大了，不可能毫无意义。

lines.en: : But hey, at least you can take solace in the fact that I probably won’t remember any of this when I {i}do{/i} leave.
lines.zh: : 不过呢，至少你可以欣慰的是，等我{i}真{/i}走了，大概也不会记得这些。
: 你真是个怪人。
: 嗯，我知道。抱歉。

lines.en: : No, you don’t have to apologize. My boyfriend’s weird too. I’m used to dealing with your type.
lines.zh: : 不用，你不用道歉。我男朋友也怪。我习惯了应付你们这种人。

lines.en: : And, I’m sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I highly doubt the person you’re thinking of is the same one I am.
lines.zh: : 还有，很抱歉要给你带来坏消息，但我很怀疑你想的那个人跟我想的是同一个。

lines.en: : How can you know that for sure, though?
lines.zh: : 可你怎么能这么肯定？

lines.en: : Because the one I’m thinking of doesn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 因为我想的那个根本不存在。
: 好吧……至少现在还不存在。
: 我不——
: 我怀孕了。

lines.en: : My boyfriend and I came out here to collect water and brainstorm baby names. But I guess that weirdo got all delusional and ran off again. He does that some-
lines.zh: : 我和男朋友出来打水，顺便给孩子想名字。不过我看那个怪人又犯糊涂跑掉了。他经常这样——
: 别给她取那个名字。
: 你说什么？
: 总之……别取。

lines.en: : I know you probably won’t listen to me on account of me being some random guy who approached you in the dark and tried to get you to rethink one of the biggest decisions of your life-
lines.zh: : 我知道你大概不会听我的，毕竟我只是个在黑夜里凑上来、还想让你重新考虑人生最大决定之一的陌生男人——
: 这还用说。

lines.en: : But that name just...isn’t good. It’s too...big.
lines.zh: : 但那个名字就是……不好。它太……大了。

lines.en: : No one...would ever be able to live up to it, or...something like that.
lines.zh: : 没人……能配得上它，或者……大概类似的意思。

lines.en: : Well, now I’m feeling {i}more{/i} inclined to choose that name just to prove you wrong.
lines.zh: : 行啊，现在我反而{i}更{/i}想用那个名字了，就为了证明你是错的。
: 你别——

lines.en: : No, let me tell you something. {i}You{/i} don’t understand whatever it is you’re trying to say right now.
lines.zh: : 不，你听我说。你现在想表达什么，{i}你自己{/i}根本就不明白。

lines.en: : You’re just one more stupid adult who’s here to try and tell me that I’m in over my head, but you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 你不过是又一个跑来告诉我「你这是在自不量力」的蠢大人，但你错了。

lines.en: : Did the principal put you up to this? One of Yuu’s relatives maybe? Come to think of it, you {i}do{/i} look like him. And if that’s the case-
lines.zh: : 是校长派你来的？还是 Yuu 的哪个亲戚？说起来，你长得还{i}真{/i}像他。要是这样的话——

lines.en: : No, even if that’s {i}not{/i} the case, you have no right to tell me how to live my life. {i}None{/i} of you do. But you keep trying anyway. Why?
lines.zh: : 不，就算{i}不是{/i}这样，你也没资格对我的人生指手画脚。你们谁都{i}没有{/i}。可你们还是一个劲儿地来。为什么？

lines.en: : Yuu isn’t crazy. He’s just a little...off. But I love him. And we’re going to raise the most beautiful, talented child in the world together. Just you wait and see.
lines.zh: : Yuu 没疯。他只是有点……怪。但我爱他。我们要一起把世上最漂亮、最有才华的孩子养大。你就等着瞧吧。

lines.en: : Now, is there anything else? Or do I need to get the pepper spray out after all?
lines.zh: : 还有别的事吗？还是说我真得把防狼喷雾拿出来了？
: 我{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Do you know a...Saki, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 你……认不认识一个叫 Saki 的人？

lines.en: : So that’s how it is, huh?
lines.zh: : 原来是这么回事啊？
: 什么？

lines.en: : She’s such a sore loser that she had to send someone out here in the middle of the night to try and intimidate me?
lines.zh: : 她输不起到这种地步，居然大半夜派人来这儿吓唬我？

lines.en: : How much is she paying you? I’ll pay double, no- {i}triple{/i} for you to make her back off. Because this is seriously getting tiring.
lines.zh: : 她给你多少钱？我出双倍——不，{i}三倍{/i}，只要你让她别再来烦我。因为这事真是烦死了。

lines.en: : The only reason I haven’t filed a restraining order yet is for Yuu’s sake. But there are {i}three{/i} of us now, and I just can’t let this happen anymore.
lines.zh: : 我到现在没申请限制令，全是为了 Yuu。可现在我们是{i}三个{/i}人了，我不能再让这种事继续下去。

lines.en: : I think...there’s a bit of a misunderstanding here. Another...name overlap maybe?
lines.zh: : 我觉得……这儿可能有点误会。也许是又一次……重名？

lines.en: : You better hope so...because if I find out that she has anything to do with this, I’m pressing charges against {i}both{/i} of you.
lines.zh: : 你最好祈祷是这样……因为如果我查出来这事跟她有关，我会把你们{i}两个都{/i}告上法庭。

lines.en: : Now, get out of here. I have to find my weirdo boyfriend and make him carry the water.
lines.zh: : 行了，滚吧。我得去找我那个怪人男朋友，让他去扛水。

lines.en: : Wait. Your name. I still don’t-
lines.zh: : 等等。你的名字。我还是不知道——

lines.en: : My name is “Leave me alone.” Now beat it or I’ll have you trespassed. This is private property.
lines.zh: : 我叫「别来烦我」。现在滚，不然我告你非法侵入。这里是私人领地。

lines.en: : Oh, Miu. There you are. I just remembered- woah. Who is that?
lines.zh: : 哦，Miu。你在这儿啊。我刚想起来——哇哦。那是谁？

lines.en: I return to where I’m meant to be and-
lines.zh: 我回到我该在的地方，然后——

lines.en: I can vaguely recall the smell of a lake.
lines.zh: 我依稀记得一股湖水的气味。

lines.en: Is that where I went when I walked through the door?
lines.zh: 我穿过那扇门时，去的就是那儿吗？

lines.en: Was there even a door at all? Because it’s gone now and-
lines.zh: 那儿真的有门吗？因为它现在不见了，而且——

lines.en: : I wasn’t looking for anything, Nao.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没在找，Nao。

lines.en: : Why is it that almost every time I’m with you, something inexplicable happens?
lines.zh: : 为什么几乎每次我和你在一起，都会发生些无法解释的事？

lines.en: : What aren’t you telling me? Because you clearly know more than you let on. And I’m not going to keep disregarding it just because you’re cute. You-
lines.zh: : 你到底有什么没告诉我？因为你显然知道得比表现出来的多。我也不会再因为你可爱就不当回事了。你——
: {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : You have no reason to want that. And even if you do, that doesn’t explain how you can just...retrace the steps of someone else for the sole purpose of fucking with my head.
lines.zh: : 你没理由想要那样。就算你有，那也解释不了你怎么能……重走别人的脚步，就为了把我脑子搞乱。

lines.en: : How did you send me to...to wherever I just was and...why does it all seem so foggy even though it {i}just{/i} happened?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么把我送到……送到我刚才去的那个地方的？还有……为什么明明{i}刚刚{/i}发生的事，却模糊得像隔了很久？

lines.en: : How do you keep making reality seem even {i}less{/i} real than it already does? Are you aware of the way time moves here? Are you {i}part{/i} of it? I need answers.
lines.zh: : 你是怎么让本就不真实的现实变得{i}更不真实{/i}的？你知道这里的时间是怎么流动的吗？你是它的{i}一部分{/i}吗？我要答案。
: 我不信你。

lines.en: : Nao, how {i}could{/i} I believe you? You show up uninvited, whisk me away to places I don’t want to be, coerce {i}blackouts{/i} out of me and-
lines.zh: : Nao，我{i}怎么能{/i}信你？你不请自来，把我拽到我不想去的地方，还逼着我一次次{i}断片{/i}，而且——
: 对不起。
: 我还是不信你。

lines.en: : I don’t know how else to put it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还能怎么说。

lines.en: : Just take me back to the party.
lines.zh: : 把我送回派对就行。

lines.en: : Or, you know what? Fuck it. I can walk.
lines.zh: : 或者，算了。去他的。我自己走回去。

lines.en: : You probably shouldn’t stick around here for much longer, though. Something might happen tonight and-
lines.zh: : 不过你大概不该在这儿待太久了。今晚说不定会发生什么，而且——
: 她在哪儿？

lines.en: She points up at the roof.
lines.zh: 她指向屋顶。

lines.en: It was never going to be anywhere else.
lines.zh: 她本来就不可能在别的地方。

lines.en: But I’m sure that who I find up there won’t be Kaori at all.
lines.zh: 但我敢肯定，我在上面找到的绝不可能是 Kaori。

lines.en: It’ll be the ghost inside of her body — the one that crawls into my bed at night.
lines.zh: 那会是她身体里的那个鬼魂——那个夜里爬进我床上的东西。

lines.en: The one who throws herself at me in death, corrupting the innocent even after she has perished.
lines.zh: 那个死了还要向我投怀送抱、即便早已腐朽仍在玷污无辜之人的东西。

lines.en: I scorn whoever it was that brought her into this world...and I abhor whoever it was that removed her. But I thank them both as well.
lines.zh: 我鄙夷把她带到这世上的人……也憎恶把她从这世上带走的人。但我同样感谢他们两个。

lines.en: For if it were not for them and not for her, I’d never {i}be{/i} at all.
lines.zh: 因为若不是他们、若不是她，我根本不会{i}存在{/i}。

lines.en: I’d be little more than a thought...an unnamed, unwanted baby, losing breath by the second and clawing its way out of the womb.
lines.zh: 我不过会是一个念头……一个没有名字、不被需要的婴儿，一秒秒地失去呼吸，挣扎着要从子宫里爬出来。

lines.en: And it would not matter which hands are there to hold me for what is intangible can never be carried.
lines.zh: 而会有哪双手来接住我并不重要，因为无形之物永远无法被托起。
我思，故我不在。

lines.en: Let the ones who can’t have the better half of my life.
lines.zh: 把我生命中更好的那一半，让给那些得不到它的人吧。
